### 1. ROUTING ARCHITECTURE

**Root files:**
- `src/main.tsx` — Entry point: wraps `<App />` with `<Provider store={store}>` (Redux)
- `src/app.tsx` — Root component: `<Provider>` → `<PersistGate>` → `<BrowserRouter>` → `<Toaster>` → `<AppRoutes />`
- `src/app/routes/AppRoutes.tsx` — Route renderer: maps `routeConfig[]` with `AuthGuard` (protected), `PublicGuard` (login/register), and public routes
- `src/app/routes/routeConfig.ts` — **The definitive route list** with 100+ routes (see section 2)

**Route Guard System:**
- `src/protectedRoute.tsx` — `<ProtectedRoute>` component with role-based access (`allowedRoles` array), checks `auth.isAuthenticated` and `user.primaryRole`, redirects to `/login`

## Full React Frontend Analysis — Aetherion Health (v2.0.0)

### 1. ROUTING ARCHITECTURE

**Root files:**
- `src/main.tsx` — Entry point: wraps `<App />` with `<Provider store={store}>` (Redux)
- `src/app.tsx` — Root component: `<Provider>` → `<PersistGate>` → `<BrowserRouter>` → `<Toaster>` → `<AppRoutes />`

- `src/protectedRoute.tsx` — `<ProtectedRoute>` component with role-based access (`allowedRoles` array), checks `auth.isAuthenticated` and `user.primaryRole`, redirects to `/login`
